title: From Long-Form Article to Social Pack in 4 Steps
steps: Inspect template schema and slot limits via get_template_schema.
Distill source copy into structured JSON slots with your coding agent.
Run validate_template_data and preview_post to verify zero overflow.
Export final PNG, multi-page LinkedIn PDF, or 30fps MP4 via render_post.
outcome: Result: Zero cloud design APIs, 100% deterministic local output.
